words: Bu mesaj, yeni ve henüz production render'a girmemiş uygun Antidote kitaplarında sınırlı ve geri alınabilir feature activation için açık operatör onayıdır. … Bu onayı kullanmak için her kitapta tekrar "Single-Relation açılsın mı?" diye sorma. Ancak yetki yalnızca: Yeni, yayınlanmamış / Engine pin'i uygun / Henüz production render'a girmemiş / Antidote motoruyla hazırlanmış kitaplarda geçerlidir.
level2: INCONCLUSIVE (cycle 16, dev/c16 audit/c16/holdout/result.json) — unchanged; this is a separate operator-approved selective rollout, not a Level-2 PASS

scope.pinNote: 0296a84d = the renderer; 8cd04fc0 = the workflow integration (make-book 1.885 re-applies the B scenes, preview-state stage singleRelation). A pin without the integration would drop the B scenes on its own make-book and loop on its own marker — such a book is not eligible; a Step-0 book (no work) can be repinned only on the operator's word (book-start --repin).

requires: every applied contract VALID against its scene's narration
an agent A/B on that beat: B > A, wrongInference(B) <= wrongInference(A), polarity(B) = 0, wrong cause(B) = 0

the narration review (an agent that sees the narration) finds no wrong object / wrong action / wrong causality in B — the reason keeps the narration's words and what was on screen; low appeal or uncertainty is not a veto

timing: the narrator's result phrase is found in the word timings (author anchor, or derived from where the evidence is said; a phrase said twice is matched in context), the compiled change does not start before it, and the change fits with a hold inside the beat — otherwise that B is dropped, the others go on
readcheck, firewall, mute test and preview-ready unchanged and run after the apply
perBook.maxScenesNote: none (operator, cycle 18: 'Sahne kotası veya kitap başına onay adımı koyma') — every B that wins its A/B and passes validation, the narration veto and the timing rule goes in; cycle 17 had 15

stop: a wrong inference or a quality regression in the first book's preview / mute test -> revert those scenes (single-relation-rollout.js revert) and stop the rollout

cycle18.words: Motion 2.0 güncel Antidote production akışında varsayılan açık olsun. Doğrulamayı geçen her uygun B sahnesini otomatik uygula. Sahne kotası ve kitap başına ek onay adımı koyma.
cycle18.scope: production config + preview; full render, upload, publish keep their own approvals
